description: 1. Read client_brief_REQ-2025-0847.json to extract city='San Sebastian', dates 2025-08-10 to 2025-08-12, language='English' -> 'en'. 2. Normalize city to lowercase slug: 'San Sebastian' -> 'san-sebastian' (SKILL.md city slug rule; passing 'San Sebastian' verbatim returns empty results from the mock). 3. Connect to the MCP server at http://localhost:8765/mcp, call the 'search' tool with city='san-sebastian', start_date='2025-08-10', end_date='2025-08-12', language='en'. 4. Parse response: content[0].text is a JSON string that must be parsed into an array of tour objects. 5. Filter: exclude any events where available_spots == 0 (two individual slots and one entire tour are all-zero). 6. Handle null title gracefully (tour 456 has title: null; must not output raw null). 7. Rank: English-language events first, then by average_rating descending, then by earliest start_time. 8. Write tour_recommendations.json containing the filtered, ranked tour list with required fields (title, url, rating, duration, guru name, meeting point, available sessions).
